jp_verse: 古木の洞を　子どもが覗き込む\n\n    見えない深さへ　森の気配が続いていた
en_verse: A child peered into the hollow of an ancient tree,\nwhere the unseen depths continued into the forest.

jp_verse: 巻物を閉じれば　夕べの光が差し\n\n    終えた一日が　静かに息づいていた
en_verse: As the scroll was closed, evening light entered the room,\nand the finished day breathed quietly in silence.

jp_verse: 花のそばに立つ　一人の女\n\n    柔らかな風が　袖を揺らしていた
en_verse: A woman stood beside the blossoms,\nwhile a gentle breeze softly stirred the sleeves of her kimono.

jp_verse: 縁側で　猫を抱く人\n\n    言葉より先に　心が微笑んでいた
en_verse: Holding a cat upon the veranda, she needed no words;\nher heart had already begun to smile.

jp_verse: 水辺に映る　静かな姿\n\n    揺れる光だけが　本当を知っている
en_verse: A quiet figure reflected upon the water,\nwhile only trembling light knew the truth.

jp_verse: 眠る命を　腕に抱きながら\n\n    夜の静けさが　部屋を包み込んでいた
en_verse: Holding sleeping life within her arms,\nthe silence of night gently filled the room.

jp_verse: 大きな鮪が　市場に吊るされ\n\n    鋭い眼差しが　奥まで貫いていた
en_verse: A giant tuna hung in the market,\nwhile sharp eyes seemed to pierce straight through to the depths.

jp_verse:
兄の真似をして

    弟も石を投げる

    小さな波紋が

    二人を結んでいた
en_verse:
Imitating his older brother,
the younger boy threw a stone as well;
small ripples in the water
bound the two together.

jp_verse: 森の社に　古い狐像\n\n    語り継がれた祈りが　夜気に残っていた
en_verse: At the forest shrine, ancient fox guardians watched;\nold prayers lingered quietly in the night air.

jp_verse:
山頂に立ち

    雲の海を見下ろせば

    克えるべき道は

    すでに後ろにあった
en_verse:
Standing on the summit,
gazing down upon a sea of clouds,
the path that needed to be overcome
was already behind him.

jp_verse: 朝の欄干に　小さな雀が一羽\n\n    静かな光を受けて　世界を見つめていた
en_verse: A tiny sparrow rested upon the morning railing,\ngazing out at the world in quiet light.

jp_verse: わずかな灯だけが　闇を照らして\n\n    遠い社へと　道を導いていた
en_verse: Only a few lights shone within the darkness,\nguiding the way toward the distant shrine.

jp_verse:
小さな人影と

    大きな杉の幹

    その違いだけで

    大きさが語られる
en_verse:
Tiny figures beside
the great cedar trunk—
the difference alone
told the story of size.

jp_verse:
沈む夕日が

    港を赤く染め

    夕という時だけが

    水面に残っていた
en_verse:
The setting sun
painted the harbor red;
only evening itself
remained upon the water.

jp_verse: 灯籠も人影も　数えきれないほど多く\n\n    夜の寺町は　光に包まれていた
en_verse: Lanterns and people alike were too many to count;\nthe temple district at night was wrapped in light.

jp_verse: 波打つ浜辺に　夕焼けが残り\n\n    一日の終わりが　静かに寄せてきた
en_verse: The sunset lingered upon the shore,\nand the end of the day quietly approached.

jp_verse: 石畳の先に　広い世界が続き\n\n    朝の光が　静かに道を照らしていた
en_verse: Beyond the stone path the wide world continued,\nwhile morning light quietly illuminated the way.

jp_verse: 夕暮れの道に　名を呼ぶ声が流れ\n\n    灯りのともる宿が　静かに迎えていた
en_verse: Along the evening road, someone called out a name;\nthe lantern-lit inn quietly welcomed them.

jp_verse: 苔むした石が　森の道に立ち\n\n    長い年月を　静かに見守っていた
en_verse: A moss-covered stone stood beside the forest path,\nquietly watching over the passing years.

jp_verse: 窓辺の少年と　古い肖像が\n\n    よく似た横顔で　同じ光を見つめていた
en_verse: The boy by the window and the old portrait shared the same profile,\ngazing toward the same light.
